evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We train MiniCPM5-2B-Base with LoRA for 200 steps on 2,048 DAPO-Math problems and evaluate on six competition-math benchmarks.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The gain is largest on problems that GRPO solves only some of the time and grows with $k$ in pass@$k$, reaching 13.8 points at pass@32.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: MCPO beats an unmodified GRPO baseline for all five data seeds, by 6.55 points of macro avg@32 on average (95\% CI $[4.1, 9.0]$), and a Qwen3-4B-Base replication improves for all three seeds ($+4.75$).
